name: chrisx
description: Get more customers by copying what already works in your industry. ChrisX is the tool. This plugin and the ChrisX connector let your own Codex do the work inside it: set up your marketing, make your shorts, cut your long videos.

interface.shortDescription: Do your marketing in ChrisX with your own Codex
interface.longDescription: ChrisX is the tool: Website & funnel, CRM & automation, and Content & ads. This plugin connects your ChrisX workspace to Codex, sets up your marketing in order, and cuts your phone videos into finished shorts and your long takes into YouTube-ready videos on your own computer.
